Which part of Tibet fascinated you the most? Share your thoughts below, and subscribe for more journeys! 🌍

comments.author: @peterfillippsss
comments.text:
Hello again Epic Earth, so good to see you present another masterpiece. That was visually stunning.
I got your notification this morning, i was relieved as it is usually the preceding night for me. As aways your documentaries are such a highlight for me each week. I like how you showed the different areas, towns and cities. Such differences throughout the country was nice to see. Seeing the sheep being run across the ice was awesome. 
Thankyou for giving an update on the Langtang area after the devasting flood that went through the area. Such a terrible natural disaster. 
I have no idea how you make these documentaries, but you do such a great job incorporating the history, Stunning visuals of the country side and then explaining the all about the inhabitants. You really have a knack for what you do and it shows in your work.

I hope you are taking care of yourself and thank you once again for all your hard work bringing a joyful escape to so many people, Kindest regards.

replies.author: @EpicEarthYTB
replies.text:
Hello my friend! Seeing your comment is always the brightest part of my week! 😊 I’m so glad the notification reached you at a good time this morning, and knowing that our documentaries provide a joyful escape after your hard work means the absolute world to me.

That scene with the sheep running across the frozen blue ice is truly one of the most surreal, ancient sights on the Roof of the World! Watching those pastoralists guide their flock across the lake before the spring thaw is such a powerful testament to the bond between the people and their extreme environment. And thank you for noticing the update on the Langtang region—giving space to the realities of natural disasters and honoring the quiet endurance of Himalayan communities is something very dear to my heart.

Hearing you say that I have a 'knack' for weaving history, geography, and human stories together is such a deeply humbling compliment. It makes every single hour behind the screen completely worthwhile.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your steadfast loyalty, your gentle wisdom, and for looking out for my wellbeing. Please take wonderful care of yourself, get some well-deserved rest, and see you next week on our next journey! Warmest regards as always! 🏔🐑❄✨
